Who We Are

Your Prime Tour & Travel Partner in Uganda

Since 2008, Conservation Trips and Adventures has been creating life-changing safari experiences — with a dedication to excellence, safety, and conservation at our core. As a fully-fledged travel, tourism and conservation management company, we cater for both regional and global clients.

Uganda • Rwanda • Kenya • Tanzania — East Africa's premier safari & adventure travel company, crafting unforgettable journeys that connect travellers with Africa's most extraordinary wildlife and landscapes.

Conservation-First
Every trip directly contributes to Uganda's wildlife protection and local community livelihoods.
Regional & Global Clients
Serving travellers from East Africa and across the world with tailored, premium experiences.

Handpicked Journeys Through Uganda

3 Days Wildlife Safari

3 Days Queen Elizabeth National Park Safari

Experience the wild heart of Uganda in Queen Elizabeth National Park – home to tree-climbing lions, massive hippo pods, savannah elephants, and over 600 bird species. This 3-day adventure balances game drives, a scenic Kazinga Channel boat cruise, and golden savannah sunsets.

From $650 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
2 Days Gorilla Trekking

2 Days Gorilla Tracking – Kigali to Bwindi

A perfectly crafted 2-day gorilla trek combining the convenience of flying into Kigali, Rwanda, with the breathtaking wilderness of Bwindi Impenetrable Forest in Uganda. Come face-to-face with habituated mountain gorilla families in their misty jungle home.

From $800 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
2 Days Primate Safari

2 Days Chimpanzee Tracking at Kibale

Kibale National Park is East Africa's premier primate destination — home to 1,500 chimpanzees and 12 other primate species. Immerse yourself in lush tropical forest tracking wild chimpanzees with expert naturalist guides.

From $450 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
3 Days Wildlife Safari

3 Days Murchison Falls Safari

Murchison Falls is Uganda's largest national park and one of Africa's greatest wildlife theatres — where the Nile explodes through a 7-metre rock gap creating the world's most powerful waterfall. Game drives, boat cruises and the falls top viewpoint all await.

From $700 pp
View Itinerary Book Now
5 Days Gorilla Trekking

5 Days Gorilla Trekking & Lake Bunyonyi

An exceptional 5-day Uganda safari combining the world's greatest wildlife encounter — mountain gorilla trekking in Bwindi — with a relaxing finale on the stunning terraced shores of Lake Bunyonyi, Africa's second deepest lake.

From $1,200 pp
View Itinerary Book Now

Why Choose Us

Safari Excellence, Every Step of the Way

Gorilla Trekking Experts
Specialist gorilla permit procurement, expert guides with decade-long Bwindi experience, and group sizes carefully managed for authentic encounters.
Conservation-First Tourism
Every trip we organise contributes directly to Uganda's conservation efforts and local community livelihoods. Travel that gives back.
Custom Itineraries
Your journey, your way. Every safari is tailored to your timeline, travel style, group size, and budget — no two trips are the same.
Exclusive Safari Vehicles
Custom 4x4 safari vehicles with pop-up roofs, USB charging, cooler boxes, and first-aid kits — built for comfort and wildlife viewing.
Licensed & Insured
Fully registered with Uganda Tourism Board and Uganda Wildlife Authority. Your safety is our top priority with rigorous protocols throughout.
24/7 Dedicated Support
Your dedicated trip advisor is available throughout your journey — from first enquiry through to your safe return home.
